verdict.rationale: Caveman ships as an agent skill, and a community critique confirms it has a trigger description built for phrase-based automatic activation. It also notes the skill can be invoked directly with /caveman. That critique questions the description's verbosity, not whether it works, so it is not a dispute. missing for 10: first-party documentation of how the skill's description is engineered for context-based auto-triggering, evidence that it activates reliably at the right moment, and hands-on corroboration of automatic activation.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment

citations.quote: its trigger description is ironically verbose
